Package com.hottes.caleb.ultimateticktacktoe.gameindependant

Class MCTSEvaluator

java.lang.Object
com.hottes.caleb.ultimateticktacktoe.gameindependant.MCTSEvaluator
public class MCTSEvaluator extends Object
a MCTS evalutor takes in a inital state and returns the best move for whichever player is denoted by the marker 1. whatever is creating the evaluator needs to take care that the markers mean the right thing.
